companyDescription: Kanan is building AI software to help manufacturers and financial institutions understand supply chains, assess risk, and make informed decisions. We are bringing together a founding team across AI research, engineering, and data science.

roles.title: Chief Scientific Officer
roles.summary: Lead AI research and scientific development for systems that help businesses understand complex supply chains and make better decisions.
roles.description:
As Chief Scientific Officer, you will lead the scientific development of Kanan’s AI capabilities. You will work directly with the CEO to turn complex business problems into a focused research agenda, and with engineers and data scientists to develop methods that can be tested and used in practice.

This is a hands-on role spanning research, experimentation, and technical guidance. Your work will connect advances in AI with practical questions about how systems represent knowledge, retain context, reason under uncertainty, and learn from evidence. You will help the team choose methods on the strength of their results and understand where further research is needed. You will also help establish a shared research practice so that experiments, findings, and technical decisions remain understandable as the team grows.
responsibilities: Set the company’s AI research direction, identify the most valuable scientific questions, and translate them into practical development priorities.
Develop approaches to reasoning, learning, memory, and knowledge representation that can work across different types of business information.
Guide the use of language models, knowledge graphs, and agent-based systems, choosing methods that fit the problem and available evidence.
Establish evaluation methods for accuracy, reliability, and uncertainty, and use experimental results to guide research and product decisions.
Work with engineers and data scientists to turn research into working software, review technical approaches, and document important assumptions and limitations.
lookingFor: Strong research experience in AI, machine learning, computational neuroscience, cognitive science, or a related discipline, with relevant computational work.
Understanding of learning, cognition, and decision-making, and the ability to connect these ideas to the design of AI systems.
Evidence of developing and testing research ideas through code, experiments, or applied work, with a clear account of what the results demonstrate.
Ability to explain scientific choices clearly, collaborate across disciplines, and guide a small technical team through open-ended research problems.
niceToHave: Experience with knowledge representation, probabilistic reasoning, or neuroscience-informed approaches to AI.
Experience translating research into commercial applications and balancing scientific goals with real-world data and product constraints.

roles.title: Founding AI Engineer — Full Stack
roles.summary: Build the applications, services, and integrations that bring Kanan’s AI capabilities into everyday business workflows.
roles.description:
As a Founding AI Engineer focused on full-stack development, you will build the product around Kanan’s AI capabilities. Your work will span user interfaces, backend services, databases, and integrations, with ownership from early design through deployment and ongoing operation.

You will work directly with the founding team and business users to understand how information moves between manufacturers and financial institutions. The challenge is to turn fragmented documents, data, and working practices into clear, dependable software. You will collaborate with the Applied AI Engineer on model integration and with the CSO and Data Scientist on bringing validated capabilities into the product. You will help establish engineering practices that keep the product understandable, testable, and easy for future team members to extend.
responsibilities: Build customer-facing applications and backend services that make complex information understandable and help users complete their work efficiently.
Design databases, APIs, and workflows for supplier, order, document, and risk information, with clear relationships and maintainable interfaces.
Integrate documents, spreadsheets, enterprise systems, and external data sources, and own the production pipelines that keep this information usable.
Bring AI capabilities into practical workflows with access controls, source traceability, human review, and clear handling of incomplete or failed results.
Own deployment, automated testing, monitoring, security, and production reliability, and improve the system as usage and integration needs grow.
lookingFor: Experience building and shipping full-stack software, with strong backend fundamentals and evidence of maintaining systems after they reach users.
Proficiency in Python and JavaScript or TypeScript, relational databases, and API development, with sound judgement about data modelling and system design.
Experience integrating AI models into real applications and handling the latency, errors, costs, and testing requirements that come with them.
Ability to understand customer workflows, communicate technical tradeoffs clearly, and take features from design through deployment without a large support team.
niceToHave: Experience with enterprise software, fintech, or supply-chain technology and the integration needs of business customers.
Experience with cloud infrastructure, application security, or an early-stage engineering team where you owned substantial parts of a product.

roles.title: Founding AI Engineer — Applied AI
roles.summary: Build and evaluate AI systems that extract information, connect knowledge, and support complex business decisions.
roles.description:
As a Founding AI Engineer focused on applied AI, you will build the intelligence components behind Kanan’s software. You will turn research ideas into working systems that process documents, retrieve relevant information, connect facts, and support business analysis.

You will work closely with the CSO on scientific approaches and with the Full Stack Engineer on deployment and integration. This role combines strong coding with disciplined experimentation: implementing a method, measuring how it performs, understanding where it fails, and improving it. Your work will help make AI outputs useful and traceable when source information is fragmented, incomplete, or contradictory. You will maintain clear records of experiments and reusable evaluation tools so improvements can be checked and reproduced by the rest of the team.
responsibilities: Develop AI agents, document-processing pipelines, and retrieval systems that work with a mix of structured records and unstructured business information.
Build knowledge-graph and information-extraction components that connect entities and relationships while preserving links to the sources behind them.
Implement and compare models, research methods, and reasoning approaches, using reproducible experiments to understand performance and practical tradeoffs.
Create evaluation datasets and tests for accuracy, grounding, and failure handling, including difficult cases where the system should request review.
Work with the CSO and Full Stack Engineer to deploy validated capabilities, investigate errors, and improve quality, latency, and cost over time.
lookingFor: Strong Python and software-engineering skills, with experience building maintainable components, writing tests, and debugging systems that use multiple data sources.
Hands-on experience with language models, retrieval, and agent workflows, including examples that go beyond a demonstration or isolated notebook.
Understanding of machine learning, experimentation, and model evaluation, with the ability to choose useful metrics and interpret results critically.
Ability to implement research ideas, explain their strengths and limitations, and collaborate with researchers and product engineers to deliver practical results.
niceToHave: Experience with entity resolution, knowledge graphs, document AI, or extracting structured information from complex documents.
Experience with model adaptation or combining machine learning with structured rules, especially where outputs need to be reviewed and explained.

roles.title: Founding Data Scientist — Supply Chain & Risk
roles.summary: Develop models that help manufacturers and financial institutions understand supply-chain performance, operational constraints, and risk.
roles.description:
As a Founding Data Scientist, you will develop the quantitative methods behind Kanan’s supply-chain and risk capabilities. Your work will connect operational data with practical questions about production, delivery, and the financial constraints that affect business performance.

You will work with manufacturers, business stakeholders, and the founding team to understand how processes operate and which outcomes can be measured. You will build models, test their assumptions, and explain what the evidence supports. Working with incomplete data is part of the role, as is identifying which additional information would make an analysis more useful. You will document assumptions and model behaviour so that colleagues can review the analysis and understand when a result needs further investigation.
responsibilities: Analyse supplier, production, order, and financial data to identify patterns, constraints, and sources of operational risk.
Model lead times, capacity constraints, supplier dependencies, and delivery risk, reflecting how real production and supply-chain processes work.
Use statistical modelling, simulation, and optimization to assess scenarios and understand how different assumptions affect the results.
Evaluate how supply disruptions, changing input costs, and financial constraints affect production and fulfilment in specific business situations.
Validate models against observed outcomes, assess their reliability, and communicate uncertainty and limitations clearly to technical and business audiences.
Work with operators and engineers to define useful measurements, improve data quality, and turn validated analysis into product capabilities.
lookingFor: Applied experience in supply-chain data science, operations research, industrial engineering, or quantitative risk, with evidence of solving operational problems.
Strong Python, SQL, probability, and statistics, and the ability to build and explain your own analytical models.
Experience working with incomplete operational data, testing assumptions, and validating models against outcomes rather than relying only on historical fit.
Ability to connect analytical findings to business decisions and learn directly from the people responsible for production, procurement, or finance.
niceToHave: Experience in manufacturing, logistics, working-capital analysis, or financial risk involving the operations of a business.
Experience with stochastic modelling, sensitivity analysis, or simulation of production and supply-chain systems under uncertainty.
